item: R123 follow-ups: the keyword summary names its window and cap, the Diagnostics hover names the digest's time limit, 20 dead locale keys pinned gone, volume_job cuts on the runlog constants, the slot-producer allowance keyed by place
key_paths: src/api/diagnostics/keywords.py; src/backup/volume_job.py; src/static/index.html; src/static/locales/*.json; tests/test_keyword_log_buttons_removal.py; tests/test_failure_scrub.py; tests/test_runs_log_sinks.py
summary: A keyword set's summary.json method names the window it was built for (every keyword only where nothing is cut and no byte cap is on; top N, ranks a to b, and a byte-cap clause otherwise) instead of top 5000 PER language; the Diagnostics hover names the digest's own time limit beside the Quick time and the memory in 12 locales, the manual and the plan; the evidence test drops three asserts that could not fail and pins the All keywords summary, a later page and the byte-cap case; 20 locale keys nothing renders are removed from the 12 locales and pinned gone from the locales and every static js/html; volume_job's six literal cuts (2000, 8000) use runlog.FAILURE_MSG_KEEP and FAILURE_TRACEBACK_KEEP with a test that shrinks the constants; the slot-producer allowance in the sink guard is keyed by module, owning function (class path included) and text with a count. Left and handed on: two said[:500] cuts in volume_job.py and the sweep table keyed by bare function name.
